- **Use After Free [CWE-416]: HIGH SEVERITY**:  
  Some external entry points reuse pointers after their referenced objects have been freed inappropriately (`process_external_request`). Attackers might trigger race conditions here, causing predictable buffer overruns or program crashes.

- **Double-Free [CWE-415]: MEDIUM SEVERITY**:
